lines.trans: Three million deposit and two hundred thousand monthly rent!
Does any sunlight actually reach down in here?
It is a half-basement, so half the sun gets in! Hey, at least it faces south.
Seventy million key-money lease? Whoa—is all that your own savings?
Twenty million of it is a bank loan!
Good for you—seriously impressive!
I really worked my tail off all these years—counting from college, does this move make fourteen times?
House-hunting and packing boxes made me sick and tired, and now I finally have a home of my own!

words.gloss: was sick to death of, yet

lines.trans: Anyway Joon-mo, thank you for everything!
What is the big rush—save your thank-yous until after you actually move out.
